entities.summary: Sima, a notable figure in the history of Indonesia, associated with Early Indianized Kingdoms (500–700). Preceded by Kalingga and Early Javanese Polities and Tarumanagara. Their legacy influenced Kedukan Bukit inscription — earliest evidence of the Srivijayan polity.
